seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Beaver, PA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Beaver, Pennsylvania for 2026: Santa visits, parades and lights, with dates and prices checked.
lede: Beaver County kicks off Christmas the weekend after Thanksgiving with a Light Up Festival in Beaver, a Beaver Falls parade and tree festival, a model railroad open house in Monaca and a historic village in Ambridge.
celebrates: The Borough of Beaver holds its Light Up Festival Weekend on November 27 and 28 in downtown Beaver, with a parade and photos with Santa. Beaver Falls holds its Christmas Parade on Saturday evening, running along Seventh Avenue. In Monaca, the Beaver County Model Railroad and Historical Society opens its layout to visitors on weekends from November 28 through January 3, 2027. Brady's Run Lodge in Beaver Falls hosts a Christmas Tree Festival from November 26 to 29, and Old Economy Village in Ambridge decorates its historic buildings for Christmas at the Village on December 5 and 6.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap, so this page uses each host's 2026 listing. The borough lists its festival as an annual weekend event and the Beaver Falls calendar calls its parade the Annual Christmas Parade.
facts: The Beaver Light Up Festival centers on Third Street and Irvine Park. The model railroad society lists open house hours of noon to 5 pm and welcomes donations instead of charging admission. The Beaver Falls parade runs from 6 to 7 pm, with a route from 17th Street to 10th Street, according to the community calendar.
trains: Beaver County has a model train stop. The Ohio Valley Lines Model Railroad Holiday Open House at the Beaver County Model Railroad and Historical Society in Monaca is free, with donations welcome, on weekends from November 28 through January 3, 2027. We did not find a full size holiday train ride for 2026.

faq: The borough holds a Light Up Festival Weekend on November 27 and 28 with a parade and photos with Santa. Beaver Falls holds a parade the next evening and Monaca opens a model railroad layout on weekends.
Is the Beaver Light Up Festival free?
Yes. The borough lists the parade and photos with Santa as free.
When is the Beaver Falls Christmas Parade?
Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 6 to 7 pm, according to the Beaver Falls community calendar.
Is there a holiday train near Beaver?
The Beaver County Model Railroad and Historical Society holds a free model railroad open house in Monaca on weekends from November 28 through January 3, 2027.
Is there a Christmas tree festival in Beaver County?
Yes. The Brady's Run Christmas Tree Festival at the Lodge in Beaver Falls runs November 26 to 29, 2026, and Old Economy Village in Ambridge holds a Festival of Trees on weekends through December 20.
Belsnickel is the Pennsylvania Dutch Santa Claus, and he visits children at Old Economy Village's Christmas at the Village on December 5 and 6.
